title: Add general reasoningMaxTokens reasoning token budget across Viwo Settings, LLMClient, and Benchmark Lab

sections.what: Add a general reasoningMaxTokens parameter (0 = Auto) across CONFIG_SCHEMA, Settings -> Model Hub, LLMClient, and Benchmark Lab (/bench), routing provider-native numeric reasoning budgets when supported and auto-degrading cleanly on HTTP 400/422.
sections.why: llm-client.ts currently hardcodes reasoning.max_tokens = 2048 (1024 for plan) on OpenRouter with no user setting, and Benchmark Lab has no reasoning token budget control alongside reasoning_effort.
sections.how:
1. Add reasoningMaxTokens (default 0 = Auto, min 0, integer) to CONFIG_SCHEMA and toLLMConfig() in static/js/config.ts.
2. Expose Reasoning Token Budget input in Settings -> Model Hub (templates/index.html, ui-controller.ts, settings-view.ts) and Benchmark Lab sidebar (templates/benchmark.html, benchmark.js).
3. Update static/js/llm-client.ts and routes/benchmark.py to forward provider-native numeric reasoning budgets when > 0, omit conflicting effort where required, drop the hardcoded 2048/1024 cap when 0, and preserve HTTP 400/422 auto-degrade.
4. Add unit/route tests in tools/unit/test_config_schema.js and tests/test_benchmark_routes.py.
sections.verify:
1. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs test_config_schema.
2. Run python -m pytest tests/test_benchmark_routes.py -q verifying reasoning_max_tokens forwarding and Auto (0) omission.

acceptance.text: CONFIG_SCHEMA in static/js/config.ts includes reasoningMaxTokens (number, default 0 = Auto, min 0, integer) persisted and exposed in toLLMConfig()
Settings -> Model Hub and Benchmark Lab (/bench) sidebar both expose a Reasoning Token Budget input (0 = Auto) persisted and recorded in benchmark run configs/exports

static/js/llm-client.ts and routes/benchmark.py send provider-native numeric reasoning budgets when reasoningMaxTokens > 0 (e.g. reasoning.max_tokens on OpenRouter/local, thinking.budget_tokens on Anthropic-style), omit conflicting effort where required, remove the hardcoded 2048/1024 fallback when 0, and preserve HTTP 400/422 auto-degrade
npm run build:ts, node tools/unit/run.cjs test_config_schema, and pytest tests/test_benchmark_routes.py pass with zero em-dashes

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Settings -> Model Hub (beside Max Tokens / Thinking Effort) and /bench sidebar (beside Reasoning Effort).

Current availability: Only binary thinking + reasoningEffort exist; llm-client.ts hardcodes max_tokens 2048/1024 on OpenRouter with no user control.

Live verification steps:
1. Open Settings -> Model Hub and set Reasoning Token Budget to 0 (Auto) or 4096; verify persistence across reload.
2. Open /bench, set Reasoning Token Budget, run a model, and verify payload forwarding and Export JSON config.
